description: This file defines a PHP trait 'StringTranslationTrait' used in Drupal for handling string translation functionalities, including methods for translating strings, formatting plurals, and managing translation services.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Translates a string to the current or specified language, returning a TranslatableMarkup object.

methods.name: formatPlural
methods.description: Formats a string based on a count, supporting pluralization.

methods.name: getNumberOfPlurals
methods.description: Returns the number of plural forms supported for a given language.

methods.name: getStringTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves the string translation service, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setStringTranslation
methods.description: Sets the string translation service to be used by the trait.
